record.dic_text:
06255 `Asht@roth Qarnayim {ash-ter-oth' kar-nah'-yim}

源自 06252, 為07161的雙數型; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Ashtoreth Karnaim 1; 1

亞特律．加寧 = "雙角或雙峰的亞斯她錄"
1) 在約旦河東邊巴珊的一個城市, 分給瑪拿西支派 （#創 14:5|）

06255 `Asht@roth Qarnayim {ash-ter-oth' kar-nah'-yim}

from 06252 and the dual of 07161;; n pr loc

AV - Ashtoreth Karnaim 1; 1

Ashtoreth-karnaim = "Ashtoreth of the two horns or peaks"
1) a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh
   1a) same as 06252
